You read the turn of the beast’s weight and strike where its next step must fall, driving it toward the ground you chose.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One visible creature: adjacent with a melee weapon, or within 8 squares with a ranged weapon and ammunition.
Duration
Damage and movement are immediate; Slowed decays normally.
Equipment / acquisition
On learning, choose one ordinary melee weapon or one ordinary ranged weapon with a d8 ammunition bundle; grant each chosen item only if absent. Each item is Bulk 1. Each use requires the equipment for its chosen attack mode.
Limits
One attack per use.
Type
Signature

Choose melee or ranged before rolling Knowledge. Make one attack.

Weak
Deal 4 physical damage and push the target 1 square.
Standard
Deal 5 physical damage and push it 2 squares.
Strong
Deal 7 physical damage, push it 3 squares and apply Slowed 2.

After resolving the attack, you may move 1 square without provoking. Ranged use checks ammunition once after the attack. These are complete outcomes; this card requires no earlier signature.

Additional rulings
